name: Rookie Yard
blurb: Learn the controls and the basics of the test.

name: Shape & Color Row
blurb: A sign's shape and color tell you what it means before you can read it.

name: Regulatory Strip
blurb: Signs that tell you the law. You must obey them.

name: Warning Hills
blurb: Yellow signs that warn you about what is ahead, including railroad crossings.

name: Guide & Work Zone
blurb: Orange work zones, flaggers, guide signs and service signs.
manualSections: Section 2: Message Boards, Rumble Strips, Slow Moving Vehicles

name: Signal Junction
blurb: Traffic lights, arrows, lane signals, pavement lines and painted curbs.

name: Right-of-Way Crossroads
blurb: Who goes first: stopping, yielding, roundabouts, school buses and emergency vehicles.
manualSections: Section 3: Yielding to Vehicles with Flashing Lights

name: Speed & Distance Highway
blurb: Speed limits, stopping distance, following distance and scanning the road.

name: Lane & Pass Parkway
blurb: Changing lanes, passing, turning, signals, blind spots, backing and parking.

name: Shared Road
blurb: Pedestrians, bicycles, motorcycles, trucks, trailers and light rail.

name: Storm Pass
blurb: Headlights, night, fog, rain, snow, deer, crashes and traffic stops.

name: Zero Tolerance
blurb: Aggressive, distracted, drowsy, drunk and drugged driving.

name: Buckle Bay
blurb: Seat belts, air bags and child safety seats.
manualSections: Section 4: Seat Belts, Air Bags and Child Safety Seats

name: Court Street
blurb: Suspensions, revocations, demerit points and insurance rules.

name: DMV Plaza
blurb: Testing rules, vision, learner's permits, license types and other DMV rules.

name: Exam Day
blurb: The real thing: 10 sign questions, then 30 general questions.
